o1: Enables small GTPase binding activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-positive bacterium; excretory system development; intracellular signaling cassette; P12 fate specification; and vulval development (including vulval fate specification). Is expressed in head neurons and vulval precursor cell. Is part of Ras protein signal transduction. Is predicted to interact with let-60. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Noonan syndrome (multiple); Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines (multiple); carcinoma (multiple); cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome (multiple); and central nervous system benign neoplasm (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including BRAF (B-Raf proto-oncogene, serine/threonine kinase).
